# Practice Gazer

*Large Aberration, Lawful Evil*

- **Armor Class**: 16
- **Hit Points**: 90 (12d10 + 24)
- **Speed**: 5 ft., Fly 30 ft. (hover)
- **Initiative**: +6 (16)

| STAT | SCORE | MOD | SAVE |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Str** | 12 | +1 | +1 |
| **Dex** | 14 | +2 | +2 |
| **Con** | 15 | +2 | +6 |
| **Int** | 13 | +1 | +1 |
| **Wis** | 12 | +1 | +5 |
| **Cha** | 8 | –1 | −1 |

- **Initiative**: +6 (16)
- **Skills**: Perception +9
- **Immunities**: Prone
- **Senses**: Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 19
- **Languages**: Deep Speech
- **Challenge**: 8 (XP 3 900, or 5 000 in Lair; PB +3)

### Traits

**<em>Legendary Resistance (2/Day)</em>**. Made-up trait text for the tests.

### Actions

**<em>Bite</em>**. *Melee Attack Roll*: +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit*: 8 (2d6 + 1) Piercing damage.

**<em>Practice Rays</em>**. The gazer shoots one of these rays (roll 1d2):

**<em>  1: Dull Ray</em>**. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 14. *Failure*: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage. *Success*: Half damage only.

**<em>  2: Slow Ray</em>**. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 14. *Failure*: The target's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

### Legendary actions

Legendary Action Uses: 2. Immediately after another creature's turn, the gazer can expend a use to take one of the following actions.

**<em>Stare</em>**. The gazer uses Practice Rays.

### Description

A made-up floating eye for the tests. It casts *[Light](https://www.aidedd.org/spell/light)* at will.

**Treasure**: Arcana
